citation: Swezey, C.S., Schultz, A.P., Doar, W.R., Garrity, C.P., Bernhardt, C.E., Crider, E.A., Edwards, L.E., and McGeehin, J.P., 2019, Geology of the Hardeeville NW quadrangle and parts of the Brighton and Pineland quadrangles, Jasper County, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Map SIM-3424, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: OCR of two map sheets; description-of-map-units columns are interleaved, so quotes are short single-line excerpts. Symbol OCR misreads read as likely ones and flagged inferred: 'Qsmi'=Qsm1, '[emp'=Qsmp2, 'Qsim3'=Qsm3, 'Qsm6'=Qsm5 (unclear). Qs3 thickness line and Qsm2 unit-1 thickness garbled; not recorded. Auger-core labels, coordinates, total depths, land-surface elevations and the tops of Ngsm and Nsm in cores on cross sections A-A' (fig. 2) and B-B' (fig. 3) read from page images of the cached PDF; elevations read off the section scale (meters, sea level) are inferred. OCR text pairs total depths with the wrong cores on B-B'; the image readings were used. Table 1 OSL rows are garbled except locations; only samples whose depth and preferred age are given in the text recorded. Figure 1 (Porters Landing, Georgia side) and Georgia-only references not recorded. Fig. 4 core description depths not legible in text; radiocarbon samples from table 3 recorded instead. Drill core C2 land surface is 8 m in table 2 but drawn at about 10 m on section A-A'; the table value is recorded.
